title: Independent static review of frozen original Root Q24 successor v3
scope: source and metadata review only; no executed Rust, original checker, deployment or behavioral result

source_checks.finding: Only a real Launch retains the private five-lane Root session. Config requires its actual original Q24 bootstrap, scoped Prepared, same original aggregate and explicitly registered retained source. No public Task/receipt/ID can construct pending authority.

Session and connection compare the same original verifier Arc, bootstrap/full identity and writer proof. Root CURRENT checks original learning initial/scope/operation and actual bound Selection. CurrentStore admits only its Root update variant, rejecting Host, RootInitial and Test.

The required original CircuitTask worker owns preparation, independent issuer response and FinalUse publication. It alone opens the existing circuit_q24_task_channel_v1 using the actual Root-published task and bound model. Pending requests reject before request queuing; no placeholder task executes later.

The same original SuccessorSlot Arc reaches both original aggregate-lane adapters. Actual State full identity, Running automation/plasticity admission and slot Installing/open status are checked immediately before and after real prepare and publish. Closing while waiting for lane prevents a not-yet-started effect.

Cancellation closes one-shot state but does not abort original effects. Required worker awaits completion; installation active count remains through actual completion. Closed state retains original handle for its pending-count drain. A handle already resolved under Ready keeps original accepted in-flight admission semantics rather than acquiring a newly invented cancellation policy.

watch subscription precedes state checks. Progress notification follows actual install_generation and observed original Selection, after the aggregate lane returns. Wait follows the preceding durable Root checkpoint and stays outside owner/checkpoint locks; original LocalDecision current authentication follows the wait. NextUse still consumes original owner readback.
Quote/post-prepare failures preserve typed original cause and say CURRENT may already be prepared. No nonce reissue, retry, reset or automatic rearm is introduced.

New context/slot/worker declarations and exports are Linux-scoped under actual parent modules. Proof and effect adapters are private children of Root stage, and Config/Launch bridges are true child modules. No test-only authority constructor is exposed.

limits: Fresh one-shot use under the same original live Root session only.
Lost CURRENT ACK consumes the original client lane; closed Pending has no automatic retry or rearm.
Session Drop fences the actual shared live verifier, and a retained verifier/current/task cannot extend authority.
A subsequent Supervisor Starting is a real new process lifetime; original source/run identity, writer, Root profile and Cell generation cannot be recreated from serialized summaries.
Installed invocation remains explicit NonLearning until separately installed real C Generator/Outcome/Dataset capability; no automatic I-to-next-A Ready.
Actual independent roles, signatures, business outcomes and holdout data remain external inputs; component builders do not supply production enrollment.
Default main remains insufficient to orchestrate all actual host entries; this slice is concrete callable product composition, not completed ordinary deployment.

two_phase_first_gap.status: CONFIRMED_SOURCE_BOUNDARY, NOT A FAILED EXECUTED POSITIVE TEST
two_phase_first_gap.finding: A same child retaining A's in-memory capabilities cannot simultaneously satisfy real Supervisor exit/new Starting and Root predecessor peer retirement. Root parent itself may remain the same PID; the original daemon peer lifetime must actually end. Releasing Rust owners/service locks or waiting for lease expiry is not process retirement.
two_phase_first_gap.needed: Original read capabilities must be legitimately reacquired across a genuine new daemon process, or a separately reviewed same-live-lifetime reconfiguration protocol is required; neither is manufactured by this pending slot.
